title: Validation studies (advisor follow-up)
source: Compiled from the saved advisor-follow-up results of the final run (hgt_vs_sage_with_cnn, cnn_error_correction, edge_perturbation, modality_intervention, hop_sensitivity). Values match the final review report. Node-level effects use all 189 test patients; Dice-damage effects use a fixed 30-patient subset.
scope: Single seed (42). 95% intervals are patient-paired bootstrap intervals conditional on this cohort and seed.

verdicts.label: Edge gates
verdicts.text: Removing the highest-gate edges damages predictions far more than removing lowest-gate or random edges.

verdicts.label: Modality Shapley ranking
verdicts.text: Agrees with modality-dropout damage; agreement is weak under noise and bias-field changes.

verdicts.label: Effective hops
verdicts.text: Most nodes sit near the two-hop cap, so there is little variation for the hop weights to explain.

tie.title: Typed HGT vs GraphSAGE under the same CNN
tie.training: GraphSAGE+CNN CNN stage: best validation Dice 0.8787 at epoch 86 (epoch cap 100, not early-stopped).
tie.reading: With the same CNN, the typed HGT graph shows no accuracy advantage over a GraphSAGE graph (difference +0.12 points, interval includes 0). The contribution of the typed graph is the explanations and their tested faithfulness, not accuracy over GraphSAGE.

cnn_error.title: Voxels the graph prior corrects or introduces (full model vs CNN only, 189 test patients, pooled)
facts: Per-patient ET Dice gain from the graph prior: +1.28 points (95% CI +0.57 to +2.17, 184 patients with enhancing tumor). The paired comparison over 189 patients gives +1.78 points; the two are separate analyses and are not reconciled.
Removing every edge of the prior costs 11.97 ET Dice points (CI +9.97 to +14.12).
69,232 of 138,143 recovered ET voxels (50%) depend on the graph edges; 54,947 of 170,159 cleared false-ET voxels (32%) do.
False ET: 170,159 cleared vs 154,092 added, so the net effect is small (+16,067). No reduction in false positives is claimed.

faithfulness.title: Edge perturbation
lines: Remove 5% of propagation edges: tumor-node flip rate 0.169 for highest-gate edges vs 0.001 lowest-gate and 0.013 random (189 patients, Holm p = 0.0096).
ET Dice damage is larger for high-gate removal at 10% and 20% budgets; WT and TC are not significant at this scope.
Whole-graph scope, 20% removed: high-gate removal costs 0.17 (WT), 0.09 (TC), 0.08 (ET) Dice points; random removal costs about zero.

faithfulness.title: Modality intervention vs Shapley
lines: Dropout: Shapley ranking tracks Dice damage (Kendall tau +0.43 WT, +0.46 TC, +0.53 ET; top-1 agreement up to 0.90 vs 0.25 by chance; 30 patients).
Noise: no agreement at graph level (ET tau +0.02); weak at final level (TC +0.30, ET +0.28).
Bias field: weak agreement (final-level ET tau +0.18).

faithfulness.title: Hop sensitivity
lines: Forcing two hops: sensitive nodes carry smaller hop weights (Spearman rho = −0.11, interval −0.12 to −0.11).
Forcing zero hops: no relation (rho = +0.02); dropping hop 1 or hop 2 gives opposite signs (rho = −0.06, −0.09).
Two-thirds of nodes have an effective hop of at least 1.90 of a maximum of 2; forcing zero hops flips 33% of tumor nodes.

notes.text: Graph vs same CNN: +1.15 mean Dice (Holm p = 0.027). HGT vs GraphSAGE with the same CNN: +0.12, interval includes 0.
Validation studies: edge gates supported; Shapley ranking and hop weights only partly supported.
Shapley attribution is feature-level: a left-out modality's node features are replaced by background values; the supervoxel partition is not recomputed.
